title: Identity and Language Learning
abstract: This second edition of Norton’s classic text on language learning and identity will bring her ground-breaking ideas to a new generation of students, teachers and researchers. Featuring a comprehensive Introduction and an Afterword by Claire Kramsch, this new edition integrates research, theory and classroom practice.

narrative:
Short impact summary

Identity and Language Learning (2013), published by Multilingual Matters Ltd, has been cited 1,716 times — enough that OpenAlex puts it in the top 1% of works in its field and year. Beyond that, it has been downloaded 369 times.

Full narrative

Identity and Language Learning by Bonny Norton was published by Multilingual Matters Ltd in 2013. Conceptually, the work connects to Identity (music), Linguistics, Language acquisition, Mathematics education and Computer science.

OpenAlex records 1,716 citations. That places it in the top 1% of works in its field and year of publication. Citations peaked in 2022 with 201 citing works. Notable citing venues include Journal of Multilingual and Multicultural Development, Journal of Language Identity & Education and TESOL Quarterly. Of 289 citation statements scite has classified, 2 support its claims, 263 mention it in passing, and none contradict it. The citing works include 1,152 journal articles, 410 book chapters and 24 dissertations. They come from 40 countries, led by the United States, Canada and the United Kingdom.

It has been downloaded 369 times via Ubiquity Press. Open Library reports a combined count of 8 reading logs and catalog editions. Its subject matter aligns with Quality Education among the Sustainable Development Goals.
